name: Kinetic Combo (Combat)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Any simple blast.

Benefit(s): If you hit a creature with your kinetic blast, until the end of your next turn, that creature takes a -1 penalty to saving throws against any utility wild talents you use that share the same element as the blast and a -2 penalty to saving throws against any utility wild talent with a different element from the blast.
